motivation: The closed single-long ATM MO identity had deeply negative typical-event economics while retaining a sparse positive right tail. This identity changes the payoff object rather than retuning event, strike distance, DTE, horizon, or exit: sell one frozen ATM directional option and buy two immediately adjacent OTM options of the same type/expiry, preserving net tail convexity while financing part of premium bleed.

user_checkpoint.instruction: 直接在云端从这个仓库往下一阶段研究

instrument_mapping.expiry_rule: identical to closed ATM-long freeze: earliest expiry strictly after inherited 1200-bar horizon date
instrument_mapping.short_leg_strike_rule: same deterministic ATM strike as the closed ATM-long freeze, including the existing OTM tie rule
instrument_mapping.long_leg_strike_rule: immediately adjacent listed OTM strike beyond the short leg within the same option type and expiry: next higher strike for calls, next lower strike for puts

entry_execution.clock: first common quote timestamp at or after underlying entry where both legs are TRADING and executable
entry_execution.short_atm: sell 1 at bid1, require bid1>0 and bid1_size>=1
entry_execution.long_otm: buy 2 at ask1, require ask1>0 and ask1_size>=2

exit_execution.clock: first common quote timestamp at or after inherited causal exit where both legs are TRADING and executable
exit_execution.short_atm: buy back 1 at ask1, require ask1>0 and ask1_size>=1
exit_execution.long_otm: sell 2 at bid1, require bid1>0 and bid1_size>=2

explicit_prohibitions: no reuse or retune of the closed single-long ATM identity
no strike search beyond the single adjacent OTM rule
no alternative event clock, success exit, failure exit, stop, target, or hold horizon
no year, regime, side, or time-of-day filtering
account_economics_boundary: A PASS would establish only an instrument-payoff research candidate. Short-leg margin, broker spread-margin treatment, portfolio concurrency and production capital usage require a later separate account-level audit.
next_action: implement results-blind runner and tests, then execute exactly once on the frozen joinable historical window
